actual_author_read_scope: All main text, methods, results/discussion, tables1–3 and figure captions read (derived lines1–1400); bibliography retained.

claims.paraphrase: NbaE/F/G/H/I/J functions are predicted by homology. NbaG decarboxylase is 251 residues in the table; no isolated NbaG activity is reported.
Constructs and enzymology characterize NbaC and NbaD, not NbaG. NbaD decarboxylates a different amino-carboxy-semialdehyde substrate.
Fe2+ dependence, histidine52/96 mutagenesis and metal inhibition belong to NbaC dioxygenase, not NbaG decarboxylase.
AP3 AmnF is identified as hydratase and AmnD as deaminase in comparative sequence context, conflicting with the2000 abstract assignments.
Insertions in nbaJ/R/D/F abolish growth on2-nitrobenzoate; gene cluster and possible polar effects do not substitute for NbaG-specific biochemical testing.
LysR motifs and insertion phenotype support a proposed regulator; detailed regulation was outside study scope.
Keto/enol labels and common downstream machinery are comparative interpretation, not exact2Z orS measurements for KU7.

limits: Reject native experimental activity code for NbaG as overstrong relative to this cited paper.
KU7 2-nitrobenzoate pathway component evidence does not establish a complete catechol route.
